name: Orb of Shadows
description: Major Invisibility for nearby allies for 15s. Out of combat only: sneak past packs.

name: Ancient Poultry Fetish
description: Chickenize! turns an enemy into a chicken. Charges are shared by the party; chickenized enemies give no kill score.

name: Humming Portalstone
description: Conjures two linked portals the party can travel between. One active portal at a time.

name: Grimoire of Resurrection
description: Resurrects a dead ally in combat.

name: Ancient Wardstone
description: Dispels magic effects from the party.

name: Shard of Antimatter
description: Interrupts the target and locks out casting for 4s (healers).

name: Sinbinding Stone
description: Reduces damage taken by an ally.

name: Chalice of Al’zerac’s Essence
description: Instantly restore 30% of your maximum mana.
